name: Doris Tong
bio: Doris Tong is an actress from Mainland China. She went alone to New Zealand when she was on sixth grade and studied there rest of elementary school as well as junior high school. She studied in the Performance Department of Beijing Film Academy in 2011.

credits.title: Being Mortal
credits.overview: Xiatian returns to her hometown to work in order to take care of her father who suffers from Alzheimer’s. She has hoped to bring comfort to her parents, yet all she can do is wait.

credits.title: Parallel Forest
credits.overview: A mother who lost her child happened to find the entrance to the parallel world after being chased by another self in the forest.
